lead: A `reject` case pins the *first* diagnostic, and the recovery type behind it writes a second one.
body: `check_read` answers `mixed` after reporting, so a `static` method declared `: int` whose body reads `$this->size` also reports `E0403 declares int but returns mixed`, and `%A` does not cover the trailing `aborting due to 2 errors`. Declare the surrounding position `mixed` (`this-is-not-read-in-a-static-method.nvst`) or pin both errors deliberately; `python tools/try.py <case>.nvst` prints the exact block to freeze, reading the `.nvst` in place.
